extraction_notes: This poll surveyed only young adults aged 18-22. All questions (pages 2-4) are opinion/preference questions about parties in the 27 October election context and perspectives on hostage negotiations, security issues, and political leadership. None of them are standard vote-intention questions asking 'if elections were held today, which party would you vote for' with a full results table showing seats/percentages for multiple parties. Therefore, no questions are extracted.
